subject.title: Android: Add message copy and text selection to chat screen

question: Should Android land only Copy and Select Copy first, or include Share and Reply in the initial long-press message action surface?
rationale: Current source proves the copy/select gap, but Share and Reply expand the action model beyond simple text reuse and the existing open implementation is conflicting, so automation should not pick the product scope alone.

options.title: Copy and Select Copy first
options.body: Ship a narrow first pass that copies whole messages and supports selective text copy while preserving link taps and scroll behavior.

options.title: Full action sheet
options.body: Approve the broader Copy, Select Copy, Share, and Reply surface and require proof that reply context is actually sent or visibly scoped as local UI only.

options.title: Defer or close direction
options.body: Leave Android chat unchanged for now and close or supersede the implementation attempts if maintainers do not want message actions in core Android.

recommendation.title: Copy and Select Copy first
recommendation.body: Ship a narrow first pass that copies whole messages and supports selective text copy while preserving link taps and scroll behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest recent history across the Android chat UI files that would own the long-press action design.
